subject: Merchant tax entity affirmation & PO preflight checklist
messages:
From: Leah Summers <leah.summers@nimbiustech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason R. <jason.r@nimbiustech.com>
Date: 2028-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup request and next steps

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick intro. We're excited to get listed as a vetted supplier for Redwood. Per your vendor portal, I attached the completed supplier intake form and our general invoice terms. A couple of items I want to flag up front so your team knows what to expect:

- Entity: Nimbus Technology Solutions, Cayman Islands holding / US branch (we bill out of the US branch).
- Tax form: our finance team said they can supply a W-8BEN-E for the Caymans entity and an EIN-backed W-9 for the US branch if needed.
- Preferred payment: ACH to our US operating account (we can provide a voided check).

Could you confirm whether Redwood needs the US-branch W-9 now, or if the W-8BEN-E for the parent will suffice for PO issuance? Also happy to schedule a 20-min call to speed up verification.

Best,
Leah
Leah Summers
Head of Ops, Nimbus Tech
attachments: SupplierIntake_Nimbus.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Leah Summers <leah.summers@nimbiustech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup request and next steps

Leah — thanks for the packet and the heads-up. Quick summary of our Procurement/Finance requirements so we can move to PO:

1) Tax doc: If Nimbus will invoice from a US branch and take ACH in the US, we need either a completed W-9 (for the US TIN) or a W-8BEN-E plus an explicit declaration that invoices will be billed by the non-US entity (and we may need a W-8BEN-E plus a US tax withholding justification).
2) EIN verification: When we received your intake, the TIN on the form didn't match the EIN in your previous saved record. To avoid PO delays, please provide one of the following so our AP team can validate the EIN:
   - Copy of IRS CP 575 or CP 575A (confirmation letter), or
   - Screenshot of your IRS EIN verification page, or
   - A recent bank statement showing the EIN (redact account numbers)
3) Signatory authority: if the person signing the tax form is not listed on your incorporation docs, we'll need a signed delegation of authority (simple one-pager).

Marcus is copied to confirm PO terms. Monica on finance will need the final tax doc + EIN proof to actually create the supplier record. If you send the docs today, our target is to have a PO ready by Tuesday next week.

If helpful I can loop in legal for any cross-border billing nuance.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Program Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
attachments referenced: Vendor-setup-checklist.pdf (PDF, 32KB)

From: Leah Summers <leah.summers@nimbustech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason R. <jason.r@nimbustech.com>
Date: 2028-09-29T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup request and next steps

Thanks, Stephanie. Quick notes and attachments — please see attached:

- W-8BEN-E_Nimbus_signed_20281002.pdf (signed by CFO) — this is for the parent Cayman entity.
- Certificate of Incorporation (Cayman) attached.
- EIN_confirmation_screenshot_20281002.png — this is for our US branch (OperatingCo USA), EIN: 12-3456789.

A couple clarifications: our US branch is a disregarded entity for local tax reporting but does hold a separate EIN for banking. We generally prefer to bill from the US branch to simplify payments and avoid withholding. If Redwood prefers us to bill from the parent, let us know and we'll issue invoices from Cayman and accept any withholding adjustments.

Would you prefer the W-9 instead of the W-8? Jason (copied) can produce a W-9 for the US branch if that's mandatory.

Regards,
Leah
attachments: W-8BEN-E_Nimbus_signed_20281002.pdf (PDF, 610KB); Nimbus_Certificate_of_Incorporation_20281002.pdf (PDF, 210KB); EIN_confirmation_screenshot_20281002.png (PNG, 95KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Leah Summers <leah.summers@nimbustech.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup request and next steps

Leah — appreciate the files. A couple procurement items to confirm before we create the PO:

- Bill-to: Redwood Inference (US entity) — please confirm which legal name you want on the invoice and which tax ID will appear. If you want the PO issued to the US branch (OperatingCo USA) and invoices to be submitted under EIN 12-3456789, we can create the supplier record as a US payee.
- Payment terms: default is Net 30. If you need Net 45 or otherwise, flag it now.
- PO account coding: we'll route to your product line (Platform Integrations). Can you also provide the preferred remit-to address and ACH details (ABA + account number) or indicate if you prefer to receive a virtual card?

Monica — once we have the W-9 (if required) and the EIN verification, please confirm AP will create the supplier and issue PO 7421-NU after standard checks.

Leah — if you can reply by EOD Tuesday with the confirmed remit details and whether invoices will be from OperatingCo USA, we'll plan to issue the PO by Thursday.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Leah Summers <leah.summers@nimbustech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jason R. <jason.r@nimbustech.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup request and next steps

Marcus — thanks. Confirming the following so we can close this out:

- Billing name: OperatingCo USA (dba Nimbus Tech) — invoices will show EIN 12-3456789.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is fine.
- Remit: ACH — ABA 021000021 / Account ****2345 (we will send a voided check via secure link).
- Attached: signed W-8BEN-E for Cayman parent (we provided because that's our corporate doc), Certificate of Incorporation, and a screenshot of EIN confirmation for the US branch. Jason will follow up with a W-9 if you still require it, but he says it may be redundant since the US operating entity has an EIN on record.

Next steps requested from Redwood: please confirm whether AP needs the W-9 (we can provide immediately), and if not, please proceed to create supplier record and issue PO 7421-NU.

Appreciate the help —
Leah
Leah Summers
Head of Ops, Nimbus Tech
attachments: same as previous

---
Notes (internal): Monica to validate EIN via IRS portal and create supplier. If EIN mismatch persists after screenshot verification, request CP 575. Target PO issuance: 2028-10-05.
